verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API reference exists, with documented endpoints such as List Models and Retrieve Model, plus a first-request quickstart. Nothing shows that reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-page, so a static reference is only adjacent to this story. The probe found no published OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), and a community user reported that there is "no simple sandbox to try OCR", which fits the absence of any try-it console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
